core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hamid is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who praises, praiser”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamid corresponds to the Arabic form حامد (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); حَامِد (Ḥāmid)). Its core sense is praiseworthy, commendable, laudable. Hamid is Arabic حَامِد (Ḥāmid) 'one who praises, praiser', the active participle of the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). The source gloss 'praised, commendable' describes the passive participle; 'one who praises' is the sense of this form. The source's Hindi column gave हरम, which is not the name and has been corrected to हामिद.

persian.name: حامد
persian.long_meaning: Hamid (حامد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن ستوده، پسندیده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: हामिद
hindi.long_meaning: Hamid (हामिद) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ प्रशंसनीय, सराहनीय है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

arabic.name: حامد
